summary: DRDGOLD Limited, a South African gold producer listed on the NYSE, filed a Form 6-K on September 1, 2026, announcing changes to its board audit committee. Mr Johan Holtzhausen will step down as non-executive director at the conclusion of the 2026 Annual General Meeting, as previously disclosed in October 2025. The board appointed Ms Charmel Flemming, an independent non-executive director since August 2020 and a Chartered Accountant, as the new audit committee chair, effective from the same AGM date. This is a routine governance matter, not a special situation event.
